rea.review: I found him to be extremely difficult for 328. Exams are comprised of only short questions, for which you need to use your intuitions to solve it. The good thing is, if you have managed to understand the concepts, you do not need to memorize anything. He often covers stuff which are outside the book, which means you always need to be attentive in his class. The overall class performance was pretty poor even after he gave us a bonus question worth 10 marks in the final examination. I got a B minus as well and I think only 4 or 5 students did better than me, so the class average grade is pretty low as well. Having said that, he is quite friendly and is always willing to provide help in his office hours.
